title: Agentic workspace descriptor
description: Machine-local declaration of a member's workspace roots, written by tools/generate-workspace-descriptor.sh and read by the workspace doctor, the digest generator, and the setup skill. The on-disk form is flat, grep-parsable YAML — one scalar 'KEY: value' line per binding, no nesting — kept deliberately parseable with bash and standard Unix tools only, so it works on a machine with no toolchain installed. Values are absolute paths and legitimately machine-specific; the file is never synced, shared, or committed. This schema documents the logical shape those flat keys must satisfy.

AGENTIC_WORKSPACE_ROOT.description: The shared workspace root. Optional compatibility context per docs/skill-binding-contract.md; never a source to derive other bindings from.

AGENTIC_PRODUCT_WORK_ROOT.description: Present only when the member declared the product-work lane as a working-materials root. Role-based, never machine-wide.

AGENTIC_REPO_CHECKOUT_ROOT.description: Declared machine-local git checkout root. Must sit outside every shared or synced tree.

^AGENTIC_WORKING_MATERIALS_ROOT_[1-9][0-.description: Ordered declared working-materials roots; the first entry is the default output destination.

^AGENTIC_EXTRA_ROOT_[1-9][0-9]*$.description: Ordered member-chosen extra roots; informational to validation.
